reviews.text: Grooming was great! Team is always super friendly!

Matt

Came here for treats for my pets and customer service was absolutely disgusting! At no moment was i ever acknowledged, ignored and when i asked for help the woman with black hair grabbed the item and turned around without saying a single word!! Rude rude rude! Don’t come here, such a turn off! Weirdos !!

Yvonne was wonderful! She was very gentle with and kind to our shy dog, which made me feel reassured dropping him off. Before she took him back to groom him, she asked me a bunch of questions to make sure we were on the same page about what I wanted done. When I picked him up, he was so happy and his cut was perfect! We are looking forward to coming back in the future :)
The lady on the phone was very rude & nonchalant.

Terrible service! Was just there to get poop bags. I was only customer, one worker on a phone (fine) and the other just roaming around the store. No one acknowledged me even after standing at counter where the phone call was happening. After 5 min of waiting i ordered on Amazon and left. thanks!
Yvonne did a great job bathing and furminating my 13 year old SIberian Husky.  She was gentle but thorough. I highly recommend her.
Is this the one or the spruce one a very different opinion? lol

The owner was so personable. Product knowledge was top notch
We learned about catnip for furry gbabies..so organized and great prices. Fun items.  Trying to find good home for fostering for pups

Beautiful clean store offering a wide variety of dog toys and accessories. Most importantly they carry some of the best quality dog foods on the market. Great customer service a kind and knowledgeable staff highly recommend!
The Staff are really helpful and care about the dogs deeply. I went in and they helped me find the best food and treat options within my budget!
I got my pup Bruno (originally Merle) from here and I have been so grateful and happy for the staff! They are extremely helpful and answer all my new puppy questions!

GREAT grooming experience. My large anatolian shepherd/great pyrenees went in looking vagrant and came out looking gorgeous. The groomer, whose name I unfortunately did NOT catch, gave her an amazing, close to body cut. I plan on booking her in the future.
Laura is great....detailed oriented, caring and my little dog loved her.
My dog was very anxious when we arrived but the staff was wonderful with her.  Lara was perfect with my dog and she (my dog) looks her best this evening

We are taking care of a relative's dog for a few weeks and the standard collar with retractable leash did not work well in a close quarters, city walking environment. We went in to find a better harness and leash and the staff was extremely friendly, and helpful. We tried on a couple of harnesses and found the perfect fit. Very grateful to the staff at this location! Also, they feature adoptable dogs in the front window and you can take them out for a walk while they wait to get adopted. I've done this a couple of times and it is a great service they provide so that the dogs can get some exercise.

Staff was friendly and a very clean store. Given the name I think it's pretty apparent they primarily cater to dogs. They do have plenty of cat stuff but it feels like 90/10 in favor of dogs. Not a problem, I just wish there was more of a selection for Cats. If you're a dog owner I'm sure you'll be satisfied.
My dogs nails look great and I know he feels great!

Love this wonderful pet store! Super clean, dogs in the front window available for adoption- and you can walk them. Large assortment of toys (cats and dogs). Wide variety of pet goods and treats, pet beds, cat scratchers, cat liter. Check them out!
Grooming was perfect!
Allison did an excellent grooming job on our new rescue doggie. She was very attentive when we spoke and handle our dog very gently. Definitely recommend her and this store.
It was a wonderful experience my pup mousse loved and enjoyed it and I was so elated to hear he was a good boy thank you for the experience I will be going back to the market street location

Got to meet the sweetest little man, Kibbles, while visiting Philadelphia this weekend. The staff was incredibly kind and helpful, we walked him twice and wish more than anything that we could have brought him home. He is fantastic on leash and really the sweetest dog. I hope that he is adopted to a loving family as this sweet boy deserves it more than anything.
Keeps dogs in the windshield with nearly no food. The fans on, which causes an eye infaction. Stresses the dog extremly out. This dog is for adoption please save him
Great job with my nervous Nellie Lab mix!!

I would like to give a shout out to Nyim G. for providing a consistently exceptional customer service experience.Exuding such a genuine warmth and kindness -  connecting with me by name and never forgetting my challenging kitty. However, it's the uplifting energy that Nyim generates that makes me  choose to shop at Doggie Style over the other equally close boutique pet shop I patron. I walk in feeling good, but I leave feeling elevated. So, in my opinion, Nyim is truly FABULOUS!
Horrible management, doesn't train. Waste of time

Doggie Style on Market St has become a weekly visit for our family. We recently adopted a dog from this location, and I honestly do not believe we would have felt as confident if it weren't for Nyim, who works at the Market St. location. He is always so warm and welcoming when we come in looking for new food and treat suggestions for our pup, and he is so knowledgeable about all the products the store has. During the adoption period, Nyim was so helpful in helping us get to know our dog and we always look forward to seeing him when we visit the store. I have recommended this store and location to many people due to the customer service and helpfulness we experience here!

Nyim is the best! He was so helpful and supportive during the adoption process. He made us feel so comfortable. He was so helpful and patient picking out supplies for our new dog, and he was so friendly and personable. We will definitely come back just for him!!
Nyim was amazing! He helped us splendidly!
This store was great. Nyim was super helpfuland so nice. He helped us pick out some great toys for our dog. Will definitely be coming back!!
Great items and very knowledgeable staff

I cannot say enough good things about Nyim at doggie style. From start to finish of adopting my dog, he guided me and informed me of everything i needed to give my boy the best life. What food to eat, leash that would work best for him, …

Nyim is AMAZING! Remembers my name every time I come in and is so helpful!! I take my dog Sadie to get groomed here and they do a great job every time. They have a great selection of food, treats, and toys for your pet!!
